JUNIOR FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER

SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENTRESTON, VIRGINIA

APPLY
Description

At MetaPhase, we believe Quirky is Cool and being authentic is the only way to be! We take the work we do very seriously and do a lot of important mission-focused work for our clients. We are individuals with different passions and strengths who take as much joy in the work we do as from those we work with. Today, we have a team that is invested in creating new solutions that lean forward, challenge the status quo, but also reflect our intimate knowledge of our customers' business. Over the years we have fostered a culture in which we are united by shared values—passion, solidarity, generosity, curiosity, and boldness—and these come alive in the work we do and how we do it. 

Together, we know our people are our difference—for our clients and our colleagues. 

Are you ready to: 

Work alongside a dedicated and diverse set of people to offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients? 

Learn and grow by taking advantage of every opportunity available to you? 

Join a company which prides itself on its shared values and inclusive culture? 

Be the difference and make it happen? 

Role Summary:

As a Junior Forward Deployed Engineer, you help deliver through MPworks, MetaPhase's AI-driven software factory. Working with experienced engineers and AI agents, you use tools such as ChallengeAI and BrickTower to build, test, and release features for federal customers.

You support our client at the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) on the Integrated Acquisition System (IAS), the enterprise system USDA's contracting community uses to plan, award, and manage its acquisitions. You learn from the people who use and own the system and contribute to moving IAS onto a modern, cloud-native platform through AI-driven delivery.

People who thrive here are curious, ask thoughtful questions, and learn by building. You bring solid programming fundamentals, interest in working with users, and a willingness to check your work, act on feedback, and raise questions early. Experienced engineers provide guidance and review as you take on more responsibility.

What You Will Be Doing:

Build and test well-scoped features through MPworks with guidance from experienced engineers. Use AI agents to assist with coding, testing, and documentation, and verify their output before submitting work for review.
Participate in conversations with USDA acquisition stakeholders, document requirements and acceptance criteria, and help prepare and demonstrate completed features.
Implement application components, APIs, and data changes on Microsoft Azure using established architecture and team practices. Support releases through approved change management and security processes.
Build accessible, intuitive interfaces and help test them against Section 508 requirements.
Write automated tests, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and contribute to CI/CD and container-based delivery with support from the team.
Explore approved AI tools and techniques, share lessons learned, and follow project rules for protecting code and client data.
Assist with existing IAS applications during the transition, including issue investigation, release validation, documentation, and security authorization evidence. Escalate production issues and work within assigned access and responsibilities.

What We Need From You (Required):

0 to 2 years of relevant software development experience. Internships, academic projects, personal projects, and other hands-on work can demonstrate readiness for this role.
Hands-on exposure to AI coding tools or agents, such as Claude Code or Codex, and the ability to explain, test, and review the code they produce.
Experience building a working application or feature through coursework, an internship, or a personal project, with an interest in learning from user feedback.
Understanding of web application fundamentals, including APIs, user interfaces, and how applications store and retrieve data; willingness to learn accessibility and cloud-native design practices.
Familiarity with Git, debugging, and basic automated testing, and an interest in learning cloud platforms, CI/CD, and containers.
Ability to write and explain code in at least one language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C#, plus basic SQL and relational database knowledge.
Clear written and verbal communication, comfort asking questions, and the ability to organize assigned work and collaborate with technical and nontechnical teammates.
U.S. citizenship and eligibility for Public Trust.

What Sets You Apart (Preferred):

Projects or internships using AI agents or AI-enabled features, with examples of how you checked their accuracy and quality.
Exposure to Microsoft Azure, containers, CI/CD pipelines, or maintaining an existing application.
Familiarity with federal software delivery, Section 508 accessibility, security practices, or identity and access management.
Experience building data dashboards, reports, or user-facing web interfaces.
Exposure to Oracle APEX, PL/SQL, or commercial contract writing systems such as PRISM.
Interest in federal acquisition and systems such as FPDS and SAM.gov.
A portfolio or GitHub account showing working projects, readable code, and what you contributed.

Work Location: 

Onsite at MetaPhase headquarters in Reston, Virginia. 

Travel: 

Up to 10%. 

Education: 

Bachelor's degree in a related field. 

Clearance Level: 

Eligible for Public Trust
U.S. Citizenship required

Compensation: 

Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this role in the U.S. is $85,000 - $115,000. 

Benefits & Perks: 

At MetaPhase, we care about your well-being and success. Our benefits include generous PTO, federal holidays, parental leave, comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision, life, and disability), 401(k) with company match, FSA/HSA options, commuter benefits, and much more. 

About MetaPhase: 

MetaPhase is different with a purpose — demonstrating a new approach to the industry that puts employees and culture first. We continue to be recognized by industry as one of the fastest-growing and most impactful consultancies in the nation. MetaPhase is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or veteran status, or any other factors protected by law.
